expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.n===2 && S.theta1===0 && S.theta2===45 && S.theta3===30 && Math.abs(S.i3-37.5)<1e-9 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: two polarisers, θ1 = 0°, θ3 = 30°, I3 = 37,5 % (must run before any setup)

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===3 && [...R].every(r=>r.min==='0' && r.max==='180' && r.step==='5') ? 1 : 0 })()

note: a select of two or three polarisers

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='n,theta1,theta2,theta3' && P.theta3.unit==='°' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares n, theta1, theta2, theta3
